title: app.bin is git-tracked and .gitignore has no rule for it
evidence:
# Export artifacts
export/
*.pck
...
# Blender auto-backups
*.blend1
tools/raylib-sw/
bin/
goldens/_reports/

$ git ls-files | grep app.bin
app.bin
detail: bin/ is ignored but the committed 2.0 MB app.bin at the repo root is not. Verified tracked via git ls-files in the pinned worktree. Build artifacts should not be committed.
recommended_fix: git rm --cached app.bin; add app.bin to .gitignore.

title: command.odin cites replay_test.odin, which does not exist — the convention is actually pinned in determinism_test.odin
detail: grep finds replay_test only in that comment; the real pin is test_replay_byte_identical_on_real_topology in core/determinism_test.odin. Stale filename sends the next reader hunting for a file that isn't there.
recommended_fix: Update the comment to name determinism_test.odin.

title: run_destroy frees only the two lookup maps; every other run allocation is left behind
detail: SOA arrays, packets, events, action_log, bfs scratch all leak for non-arena callers — 'odin test core' passes but its tracking allocator reports leaks (e.g. flow_test.odin:165). Fine under ODN-18 arena discipline; misleading as a 'destroy'.
recommended_fix: Either free the full set for non-arena use, or comment that destruction is the run arena's job.

title: Junction triage/endpoint lookup duplicated across flow.advance and snapshot_write
detail: Identical a-first junction-resolution logic exists in advance() and a near-copy in pick_pipe. Three homes for one precedence rule; a junction-junction policy change must find all of them.
recommended_fix: Extract one helper (e.g. pipe_junction_triage) and call it from all three sites.
